preReview.title: Vanney backs fully-fit LA Galaxy to defeat anyone in playoffs
preReview.description: With the fight for the playoff spots in the Western Conference heating up, the LA Galaxy face Austin FC in their final home game.

preReview.description: Con la lotta per i playoff della Western Conference sempre più serrata, il LA Galaxy ospita l'Austin FC nell'ultima partita casalinga.

preReview.description: Alors que la lutte pour les places en phase finale s'intensifie dans la Conférence Ouest, le LA Galaxy reçoit Austin FC pour son dernier match à domicile.
